answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register through cryptographic stake burning scaled superlinearly as $C(n) = k \cdot n^{1.5}$, where $n$ is identity count. Like a deep canyon separating genuine nodes from clones, this mathematical barrier makes mass replication exponentially unaffordable. Registration hashes are permanently stamped in umber ink on-chain, while agent credit spreads like an intertwined vine only after provable stake destruction.
